ground_truth.notes: 20-week first marathon plan for a 58-year-old at 45 mpw who explicitly runs 4 days only. Sessions MUST be 4/week — scheduling 5+ runs ignores both his stated preference and masters recovery reality. Peak week 50-58mi is appropriate; going higher raises injury risk for a first-time marathoner at this age. Long run must reach 18-20 miles — cutting it at 14mi would leave him underprepared for 26.2. Tempo work matters for sub-4:30 pacing. The plan should acknowledge recovery: why rest days matter for masters athletes and how to tell the difference between normal fatigue and warning signs.
